# Visual design Pages

Created for the owner on 2026-10-22. These private, editable Pages explain the
accepted design with nine native Mermaid diagrams, responsibility/interaction
tables and concrete examples. They are reader views, not a second specification,
policy authority or implementation ledger. The [program](README.md), owning
contracts and [work order](../../plans/agentic-engineering-uplift.md) remain canonical.

| View | Page | Canonical design |
|---|---|---|
| Overall architecture, ownership, economical reasoning and sequence | https://chatgpt.com/space/page_50673c9c545c8191bdc373d542857b0f | [Program](README.md) and [clause audit](request-coverage.md) |
| HITLMAN proposal, evidence, questions, permissions and effect boundary | https://chatgpt.com/space/page_a1b3a2a7ba9c8191b3a038eac6608d12 | [Human workbench](human-workbench.md) |
| Prose structure, provenance, regeneration, variants, diffs and publication | https://chatgpt.com/space/page_d46b86747c1c8191a39fc93711f7d5c1 | [Prose harness](prose-harness.md) |

The child Pages link to the overall Page and each other. Each names its planned
implementation status and links to repository sources. Save receipts and same-stream
readback verified all three documents and nine diagram blocks. The third pass adds
outcome-based navigation, learning and recovery flows, a publication-mode comparison,
and wide diagram blocks while keeping prose at reading width. Fresh reader tabs are
used for browser inspection because an already-open editor can retain stale content
after connector edits. This is reader-layout evidence, not future application UI acceptance.
No sharing permissions, schedules, runtime implementation or consumer adoption are
created by this delivery. Refresh these dated explanations when the owning design
materially changes; resolve conflicts in the repository first.
